**These are test builds.** They are early, unsigned, and may crash, lose data, or change without notice. Keep backups of any notes you open with them.

Downloads:

- `meridian-linux-x86_64.tar.gz`: Linux (x86_64). The Wayland pen/stylus support only exists here.
- `meridian-windows-x86_64.zip`: Windows (x86_64). Windows SmartScreen may warn because the build is unsigned ("More info" → "Run anyway").
- `meridian-macos-arm64.tar.gz` / `meridian-macos-x86_64.tar.gz`: macOS on Apple silicon / Intel. Unsigned: run `xattr -d com.apple.quarantine meridian` once, or right-click → Open.

Unpack and run `meridian`. Windows and macOS builds have had much less testing than Linux.
